---
title: "pre-whitening"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
rm(list=ls());gc()
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(forecast)


covariate_combine_region <- read_csv("covariate_combine_region.csv")
covariate_combine_division <- read_csv("covariate_combine_division.csv")

```

```{r}
prewhiten_arima <- function(x, year) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)

  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))

  if (sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-10) return(rep(0, length(x)))

  tsx <- ts(x, start = min(year, na.rm = TRUE), frequency = 1)
  fit <- forecast::auto.arima(tsx, seasonal = FALSE)
  as.numeric(residuals(fit))
}

region_pw <- covariate_combine_region %>%
  group_by(Census_Region) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    rate_health_care_coverage_pw = prewhiten_arima(rate_health_care_coverage, Year),
    rate_alochol_consum_pw       = prewhiten_arima(rate_alochol_consum, Year),
    socio_score_pw               = prewhiten_arima(socio_score, Year)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


division_pw <- covariate_combine_division %>%
  group_by(Census_Division) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    rate_health_care_coverage_pw = prewhiten_arima(rate_health_care_coverage, Year),
    rate_alochol_consum_pw       = prewhiten_arima(rate_alochol_consum, Year),
    socio_score_pw               = prewhiten_arima(socio_score, Year)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


division_pw |> write_csv("covariate_combine_division_pre_whitening.csv")
region_pw |> write_csv("covariate_combine_region_pre_whitening.csv")
```

```{r}
vars_pw <- c("rate_health_care_coverage_pw", "rate_alochol_consum_pw", "socio_score_pw")

make_corr_long <- function(df, group_var) {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      m <- cor(dplyr::select(.x, dplyr::all_of(vars_pw)),
               use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      as.data.frame(as.table(m)) %>%
        dplyr::rename(var1 = Var1, var2 = Var2, corr = Freq)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::rename(group = !!group_var) %>%
    mutate(
      var1 = factor(var1, levels = vars_pw),
      var2 = factor(var2, levels = vars_pw)
    )
}

plot_corr_heatmap <- function(corr_long, facet_title = NULL) {
  ggplot(corr_long, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = corr)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(corr), "", sprintf("%.2f", corr))), size = 3) +
    coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(~ group) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(
      title = facet_title,
      x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Corr"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# ---- Region heatmap ----
corr_region_long <- make_corr_long(region_pw, "Census_Region")
plot_corr_heatmap(corr_region_long, "Pre-whitened correlations by Census Region")


corr_division_long <- make_corr_long(division_pw, "Census_Division")
plot_corr_heatmap(corr_division_long, "Pre-whitened correlations by Census Division")
```
